LanguageData.UMW_WeaponEnabledDesc: Allow {0} to be generated. Turn off to remove it from every reward and loot pool; the other weapons fill its place. Weapons already in your save are untouched. Some mods' own loot generators may bypass this.
LanguageData.UMW_ExcludeWoodStuffDesc: Unique weapons roll a random eligible material. With this on, wood is never rolled, so a hard-won reward never lands as a wooden {0}.
LanguageData.UMW_AllowUltratechTraitsDesc: Three traits use Royalty's ultratech kit: {0}, {1} and {2}. Turn off to keep them out of the roll, for medieval or low-tech runs. Other traits are unaffected; weapons that already rolled one keep it.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesWarMerchantDesc: About half of {0} visits bring one unique melee weapon for sale, and the caravan buys unique melee weapons either way. Ultratech traits never roll on its stock: a war party deals in period arms. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesShamanDesc: About half of {0} visits bring one unique melee weapon for sale, and the caravan buys unique melee weapons either way. Ultratech traits may roll on its stock: shamans trade in relics they do not fully understand. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeCooldownDesc: Rest time between earthshakes. The default matches Odyssey's EMP pulser. 0 removes the cooldown.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeRadiusDesc: Reach of the stunning shockwave. Walls do not stop it; gaps with no floor do. It is indiscriminate: a wider radius catches your own colonists too.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryCooldownDesc: Rest time between rallying cries. Measured in days on purpose: the default makes it an heirloom moment, not a standing aura re-applied every fight.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryRadiusDesc: How far the cry carries. Rallies every non-hostile humanlike in range with line of sight; blocked by walls. Also wakes sleepers.
LanguageData.UMW_RalliedDurationDesc: How long the rallied buff lasts, halving pain and stagger time. Sleepers are woken instead, and resent it.
LanguageData.UMW_WarbandQuestWeightDesc: How often the warband quest is offered against the other opportunity-site quests (ancient mercenaries, bandit camps, item stashes...). Higher = offered more often. 0 disables it.
LanguageData.UMW_MatchVteSpearDesc: {1} draws the vanilla spear diagonally and longer. With this on, the {0} is turned and enlarged to match it in a drafted pawn's hands. Purely cosmetic. Takes effect after a restart.
